import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def boxes(d):
    H,W=len(d),len(d[0]); out=[]
    for c in range(1,10):
        cells=[(r,j) for r in range(H) for j in range(W) if d[r][j]==c]
        rs=set(r for r,_ in cells); cs=set(j for _,j in cells)
        if len(rs)<2 or len(cs)<2: continue
        r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs); r1,c1=max(rs),max(cs)
        per=2*(r1-r0+1)+2*(c1-c0+1)-4
        if sum(1 for r in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1) if d[r][j]==c)!=per: continue
        out.append((c,r0,c0,r1,c1))
    return out
H=len(G['Test input']); W=len(G['Test input'][0])
ti=G['Test input']
# For each box, aligned markers (extension of edges) with min manhattan dist, and true fill guess via count

    c,r0,c0,r1,c1=b
    al=[]
    for v in range(1,10):

                al.append((d0,v,(rr,cc_)))
    al.sort()
    print('box',b,'aligned:',al[:3])

G=load()
def boxes(d):
    H,W=len(d),len(d[0]); out=[]
    for c in range(1,10):
        cells=[(r,j) for r in range(H) for j in range(W) if d[r][j]==c]
        rs=set(r for r,_ in cells); cs=set(j for _,j in cells)
        if len(rs)<2 or len(cs)<2: continue
        r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs); r1,c1=max(rs),max(cs)
        per=2*(r1-r0+1)+2*(c1-c0+1)-4

    return out

        tgt={(rr,cc) for rr in range(r0+1,r1) for cc in range(c0+1,c1) if (rr+cc)%2==hp}

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def boxes(d):
    H,W=len(d),len(d[0]); out=[]
    for c in range(1,10):
        cells=[(r,j) for r in range(H) for j in range(W) if d[r][j]==c]
        rs=set(r for r,_ in cells); cs=set(j for _,j in cells)
        if len(rs)<2 or len(cs)<2: continue
        r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs); r1,c1=max(rs),max(cs)
        per=2*(r1-r0+1)+2*(c1-c0+1)-4
        if sum(1 for r in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1) if d[r][j]==c)!=per: continue
        out.append((c,r0,c0,r1,c1))
    return out
def solve(d):
    bl=boxes(d); H,W=len(d),len(d[0])
    cnt={v:sum(1 for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if d[r][c]==v) for v in set(x for row in d for x in row)}
    o=[row[:] for row in d]
    for v in {x for row in o for x in row}-{0}-{b[0] for b in bl}:
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(W):
                if o[r][c]==v: o[r][c]=0
    for b in bl:
        c,r0,c0,r1,c1=b; hp=(r0+c0)%2
        need=sum(1 for rr in range(r0+1,r1) for cc in range(c0+1,c1) if (rr+cc)%2==hp)
        vc=[v for v,n in cnt.items() if v!=c and n==need]
        if vc: o[r0+1][c0+1]=vc[0]
    return o
# sanity check solve vs demos still True
